notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones (gb-maps-1): a combat surf map with no finish -- 200-odd weapons, four jails, team-coloured teleports at the bottom of every ramp and a secret-button AWP room. Every trigger_teleport aims back at a spawn, a jail or the top of a ramp, so there is a loop to fight on and no line a run could end at. Not published.
